Problems in the neck or larynx, "squeezed" voice of the soul.
Personality splitting, internal conflicts and mental chaos.
Loss of intuitive vigilance leading to mistakes in choice.

Body Practice and Meditation

Meditation: Sit comfortably, focus on the throat center (neck). Visualize Psi as a shining golden bowl, into which the transparent light of Pneuma pours from above. Imagine how this light expands, forming a perfect sphere around you. Pronounce the long Ps-s-s sound as the vibration clears the channel between the mind and heart.

Magical posture: Stand up straight, heels together. Raise both hands up and to the sides, bent them at the elbows so that the forearms are pointed upwards and the palms are opened to the sky. Your body should form the shape of a trident or bowl (the outline of a capital letter Ψ). Tighten the muscles of the neck, concentrating purple glow in them. Loudly and solemnly pronounce the spell "ΨΥΧΟΜΠΟΙΑΨ".

Bodywork: Psi controls the neck. Stretching exercises of the cervical region and conscious “swallowing” of light are recommended to strengthen the connection between the intellectual and vital centers.

omega.name: Omega
omega.tagline: The Metaphysics of the Great End and the Seventh Heaven
omega.content:
Cosmogonic profile: Seventh Heaven and the Limit
In the process of unfolding the reality of the Omega (Ω, ω) acts as the final element, completing the cycle of twenty-four letters and symbolizing the "End" (Teleute - τελευτή). In Mark's Gnostic system, it corresponds to the seventh heaven and the sphere of Saturn (Kronos), being "the completion of all completions." The alchemist Zosimus of Panopolitan described the Omega as a round letter consisting of two parts, and identified it with the Oceanus (Ὠκεανός), the source and seed of all the gods. In the structure of the cosmic body of truth, it takes the place of the head (Kephale - κεφαλή), crowning the entire hierarchy of elements.

Magical attunement and root - ῥίζα

Root (seed sound): Ω (Omega) is a long vowel, symbolizing the ultimate fullness of the spirit.

Incantation: “ΩΡΙΩΝ” (Orion) or “ΝΑΡΤΟΡΑΚ” (Narthorak) are magical names of power that open access to the energies of healing and rest in the center of the universe. In Gnosis, the cry "ΩΩΩ" was considered the name of the Immortal.

Associative colors: Deep Indigo (the wisdom of Saturn), Golden (the radiance of completed work), Transparent (the purity of the heavenly vault).

Kronos (Χρόνος) as Lord of Time and the Seventh Zone. The letter is inextricably linked with Christ as the Alpha and Omega, the beginning and end of all things.
Center in the body: Head (Κεφαλή).

The numerical essence is the energy of Ogdoad (Eight) in hundreds The numerical value of Omega is 800. Its numerical root (pythmen) is 8, which connects the letter with the "first cube" (2x2x2) and the principle of absolute stability. Through isosephy (equality of numbers), Omega in combination with Alpha gives the number 801, which corresponds to the word "Dove" (peristera - περιστερά), the symbol of the Holy Spirit. The ordinal value of the letter is 24, which corresponds to the number of elders in Revelation and the number of hours in the daily cycle of the universe.

Upright position: Fulness and Creative Rest
In the upright position, Omega means the achievement of the goal, the acquisition of integrity and the triumphant completion of the path.
Final implementation of plans and obtaining the fruits of labor.
Spiritual Liberation and Return to Origin (Ocean).
Protection through awareness of oneself as part of the divine fullness (Pleroma).
The state of the Sabbath is the sacred rest after the act of creation.

Reversed position: Hysterema
The reversed letter indicates the state of Hysterema (Ὑστέρημα - "hysterema", deficiency or lack), when the soul feels lost in infinity.
Feelings of hopelessness, spiritual impasse, or a “broken circle.”
Fear of the end, inability to let go of the past.
In a mystical sense, the call of the soul from the depths of suffering: when it is involved in difficulties, it cries O! (Ω), hoping for the help of a soul mate from above.

Practice and magical posture
Meditation: Focus on the top of your head. Imagine Omega as a shining golden crown, or the dome of heaven, covering your entire being. Visualize how all your past experiences (letters) come together into this single point, turning into pure light.

Magical posture: Stand up straight, looking up at the sky. Place both hands on your head, connecting your fingers so that they form a rounded vault above the parietal (the outline of the capital letter Ω). In this pose, say seven times "ΩΩΩΩΩΩΩ", directing the sound to the heart of the sky.

Bodywork: Omega controls the head. Practices of contemplation and “mind silence” are recommended to synchronize personal consciousness with the rhythm of the Ocean of Divinity.
